description: Provision a Google Cloud Spanner SpannerDatabase via Config Connector. Fields mirror the spanner.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 SpannerDatabase spec.

databaseDialect.description:
Immutable. The dialect of the Cloud Spanner Database.
If it is not provided, "GOOGLE_STANDARD_SQL" will be used. Possible values: ["GOOGLE_STANDARD_SQL", "POSTGRESQL"].

ddl.description:
An optional list of DDL statements to run inside the newly created
database. Statements can create tables, indexes, etc. These statements
execute atomically with the creation of the database: if there is an
error in any statement, the database is not created.

encryptionConfig.description: Immutable. Encryption configuration for the database.

kmsKeyRef.description:
Fully qualified name of the KMS key to use to encrypt this database. This key
must exist in the same location as the Spanner Database. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `selfLink` field of a `KMSCryptoKey` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

instanceRef.description: The instance to create the database on. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `SpannerInstance` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

versionRetentionPeriod.description:
The retention period for the database. The retention period must be between 1 hour
and 7 days, and can be specified in days, hours, minutes, or seconds. For example,
the values 1d, 24h, 1440m, and 86400s are equivalent. Default value is 1h.
If this property is used, you must avoid adding new DDL statements to 'ddl' that
update the database's version_retention_period.

title: GCP Spanner SpannerDatabase
